# Conrad Wessel Award

The Conrad Wessel Award, or FCW Prize, is an annual prize by Fundação Conrado Wessel established in 2002 for personalities and entities in the topics of science, culture, medicine, literature and photography. It is one of the awards that gives the largest monetary value for those topics in Brazil.
Awards
Photography
It is deemed as the most traditional award of its kind for Brazil, and it has been offered continuously since 2002. It is the only FCW Prize category that features multiple winners across editions.
